name: Duanala, Skyborn
body:
Skyborn duanalas are a people of the clouds, from a world where much of the adventure takes place in the stratosphere, and the ability to cling to the bottoms of airships is a genuine boon to piracy. These duanalas can jump from one vessel to another, shaping their webs into mock-parachutes to navigate through the empty space between them.

Duanala Favored Class Bonuses

While skyborn duanalas prefer these classes, their favored class bonuses are available to any duanala.

Alchemist: Add +1/4 to the alchemist’s natural armor bonus when using the character’s mutagen.
Aurinko: Add +1/4 to the dodge bonus to AC granted by the nimble class feature (maximum +4).
Barbarian: to the barbarian’s natural armor bonus when raging.
Bard: Add +1/3 to the number of uses per day of versatile webbing.
Gunslinger: The gunslinger reduces the amount of time needed to restore a broken firearm using the Gunsmithing feat by 5 minutes (maximum reduction of 50 minutes).
Harbinger: Gain a +1/3 natural armor bonus while the harbinger has temporary hit points granted by a divine influence, invocation, or mystic arcanum.
Herald of Emotion: Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus of the herald’s hard light constructs.
Inquisitor: Add +1/2 on Intimidate checks and Knowledge checks to identify creatures.
Inventor: Add +1/2 to the inventor’s AC against critical hit confirmation rolls (max +4) while using an armor invention.
Investigator: Add one extract formula from the investigator’s formula list to the formula book. This formula must be at least 1 formula level below the highest level the investigator can create.
Key Guardian: Add +1 to the key guardian’s CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.
Magus: Add a +1/2 bonus on concentration checks made to cast defensively.
Mortifex: Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus of the mortifex’s undead companion. If the mortifex ever replaces his undead companion, the new undead companion gains this bonus.
Necromancer: Deal +1/2 cold damage with necromancer spells and effects that deal damage.
Oracle: Add +1/3 to the number of uses per day of versatile webbing.
Summoner: Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus of the summoner’s eidolon.
Swashbuckler: Add +1/3 to the number of uses per day of versatile webbing.
Valomancer: Add one schematic known. This schematic must be drawn from an unattended object.
Warshade: Gain a +1/4 bonus on damage rolls with dark blast and dark slam when the war shade has at least 1 burn.
Wizard: Deal +1/2 cold damage with wizard spells and effects that deal damage.
Yosuren: Add +1/3 to the number of uses per day of versatile webbing.
Skyborn Duanala Heritage Traits

Skyborn duanalas share ancestry traits with other members of their ancestry. For ease of reference, their shared traits are presented here as well.

Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, –2 Constitution, –2 Wisdom. Skyborn duanalas are both agile and intelligent, but they can be overconfident despite their frail bodies.
Size: Medium. Duanalas are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Duanalas have a base speed of 30 ft. They are always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump.
Multi-Limbed: Skyborn duanalas have six legs and two arms, granting them a +8 racial bonus to CMD against trip attempts.
Type: Aberration. Skyborn duanala are naturally born as spider-like beings. Their creature type is aberration.
Low-Light Vision: Duanalas can see twice as far as humans in conditions of low-light.
Expert Climber: Duanalas have a climb speed of 20 feet, and are treated as being constantly under the effects of a non-magical spider climb spell, save that they cannot cling to per fectly smooth surfaces, such as a wall of force. This grants them a +16 racial bonus on Climb checks.
Versatile Webbing: Skyborn duanalas can use their natural webbing to perform the following tasks a total number of times per day equal to 2 + their Constitution modifier (minimum 1). The duanala treats its character level as its caster level when performing these tasks. Any fire damage dealt in the same space as these effects causes them to end immediately (which may trigger an alarm).
Create a non-magical feather fall effect. While in midair, the duanala can move up to 5 feet in any horizontal direction for every 1 foot it falls, at a speed of 60 feet per round. It cannot gain height; it merely coasts in other directions as it falls. If subjected to a strong wind or any other effect that causes a creature with gliding wings or a similar ability to rise, it can take advantage of the updraft to increase the distance it can glide.
Create a non-magical alarm, shield, or web effect. The web only lasts for 1 round per level (minimum 3 rounds).
Languages: Common and Aklo. Duanalas with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Elven, Sylvan, and Undercommon.
